correctness.rationale: The edge-forest complex is precisely the graphic matroid independence complex on nine K3,3 edges, rank five. Matroid shellability implies its labelled homotopy type is wedge of four-spheres; exact forest counts (9,36,84,117,81) yield Euler wedge multiplicity 20. Nonfree H=S3×S3 and full G=H⋊C2 orbit quotients are modeled correctly by barycentric FLAG orbit cells with rank-preserving stabilizers; an ordinary quotient requires these flag orbits, not a false simplicial vertex-orbit quotient. Independently reimplemented exact enumeration of all 327 nonempty faces, all 36/72 group elements and Burnside flag counts, independently formed cellular boundaries and verified every ∂²=0. H orbit cells [20,162,504,630,270], G [14,92,260,315,135]. Exact integral ±1-pivot chain cancellations were independently performed, H degrees (1,2,3,4) [19,143,361,269], G [13,79,181,134], leaving a generator at C0 and C4 and no torsion (homology, NOT asserted simplicial collapse). Both quotient fundamental groups vanish by Armstrong because transpositions within shores and the shore-swap have fixed singleton edge vertices and generate the groups. With π1=0 and homology S4, Hurewicz/Whitehead imply genuine homotopy equivalence to S4, not manifold homeomorphism. Finite enumeration is exhaustive for THIS graph/groups and standard topology upgrades it; none is extrapolated to larger n.

value.rationale: K3,3 is the smallest balanced nonplanar complete bipartite graph and supplies a canonical rank-five, nine-edge graphic matroid. Its labelled independence complex has twenty S4 summands, while both natural nonfree symmetry quotients unexpectedly have homotopy type a single S4. This is a complete exact integral homotopy classification for two meaningful quotients, revealing what survives under full shore symmetries; different octahedral forest quotients can have 2-torsion, so the phenomenon is not generic or a table-recomputation triviality. Homotopy rather than mere rational Betti counts matters.

limitations: Only ordinary orbit spaces of this exact 9-edge K3,3 forest complex under H and G; does not establish homeomorphism/manifold or subgroup-by-subgroup classification; complex flag certification finite/exhaustive, general topological implications standard.
